abstract-092: A black square containing an S-curved white channel linking two rows of three dots, flanked by tapering corner slivers.
abstract-107: An eight-pointed star frame enclosing a rising sun with radiating triangular rays above a solid horizontal band.
air-man: A rounded body shape with a circular vent flanked by angled eye-like slits, above a three-bladed pinwheel fan and short vertical vents.
architect-mask: An egg-shaped mask with two narrow eye-shaped slits, each centered on a small circle, tapering to a point at the chin.
aries: A pair of curling ram's horns joined at a stem, the zodiac glyph for the sign Aries.
bellows: A wedge-shaped bellows with an accordion-folded body, a narrow nozzle at one end and a rounded handle at the other.
bowen-knot: Two square-cornered loops interwoven into a continuous knot with four rounded loop ends, a heraldic emblem of eternity.
boxing-glove: A padded boxing glove with a curved thumb section overlapping the fist and a cuff at the wrist.
broccoli: A cluster of rounded florets atop a tapering stalk, marked with a few thin curved lines.
burning-eye: A flame shape enclosing concentric rings around a round eye at its center.
butter-toast: A slice of bread with a knife spreading a pat of butter diagonally across it, above a curved shape suggesting a stack of slices.
cabbage: A round cabbage head formed of overlapping wavy leaves with veined ribs and jagged edges at the top.
card-exchange: Two rounded rectangular cards side by side, linked above and below by curved arrows forming a cycle.
card-king-spades: A playing card bearing spade pips in opposite corners and the letter K beside a symmetrical face design, the King of Spades.
coffee-mug: A mug with a large looping handle and an oval rim showing a swirl of liquid inside.
concentric-crescents: A circle formed of nested crescent shapes spiraling inward toward a small central circle.
corn: An ear of corn covered in a crosshatched kernel pattern, its husk leaves curling back along one side.
crossed-axes: Two axes crossed with blades pointing outward, handles crossing near the bottom, the crossed-weapon motif for battle or conflict.
crossed-pistols: Two revolvers crossed diagonally over each other, hammers cocked and muzzles pointing outward.
crystal-growth: A cluster of angular crystal spires of varying heights growing together, each faceted with a light highlight strip.
dream-catcher: A hoop containing a woven flower-like web around a central hole, hung with feathers and flanked by two smaller feathered hoops, a Native American charm believed to filter dreams.
energy-shield: A rounded shield shape filled with a honeycomb grid of hexagonal cells, each topped by a small circular node.
energy-sword: A curved, hollow-bladed sword tapering to a sharp point above a hand gripping its short handle.
feather: A single large feather with a curved quill shaft and windswept barbs trailing to one side.
flamethrower: A rifle-shaped weapon with a flame burst at its muzzle, linked by a hose to twin tanks worn on the back.
fox-head: A fox's head with tall pointed ears, a long snout, and jagged fur tufts along the jaw, emblematic of cunning.
galley: A hulled boat marked with diagonal hatching along its waterline, topped by several vertical masts each crossed by a horizontal yard.
icarus: A falling human figure with one feathered wing trailing beneath jagged sunburst rays, depicting Icarus after flying too near the sun.
infinity: A horizontal figure-eight loop, the standard symbol for infinity or endlessness.
jungle: Repeating palm trees with curved trunks and fanning fronds, interspersed with grass tufts and a curved vine, tiled across the frame.
kitchen-knives: Three knives with blades pointing in different directions, scattered together with overlapping handles.
laser-warning: A rounded warning triangle enclosing a radiating starburst crossed by a horizontal beam, the standard hazard symbol for laser radiation.
liquid-soap: A pump-top dispenser bottle with an angled spout above a conical body marked by a single large teardrop shape.
lizardman: A rounded hooded head with two small round eyes above a wide mouth full of jagged teeth, like a reptilian monster.
lungs: A pair of lung shapes joined by a windpipe that forks into a Y at the top.
mine-explosion: A jagged burst of spikes radiating outward above a dark crescent shape at its base.
north-star-shuriken: A five-pointed star framing a smaller pinwheel of triangular blades around a central circle, resembling a compass rose within a shuriken.
open-treasure-chest: An open chest tilted back, revealing a pearl necklace, a flame, and a small locked box amid scattered coins.
overdose: Three oblong two-toned capsule pills scattered at different angles.
overdrive: A toothed gear ring with a needle across its center dial, wrapped in swirling curved lines suggesting rapid spinning motion.
pick-of-destiny: A skull-like face flanked by two large spiral horns curling outward above a fanged jaw, a common mark of a demon or devil.
player-next: Two identical person silhouettes with an arrow pointing from the first toward the second above their heads.
praying-mantis: A mantis in profile with a triangular head, one large round eye, folded forelegs, and long trailing hind legs.
relationship-bounds: Two identical person silhouettes whose heads and torsos are joined by a wide striped band between them.
rialto-bridge: An arched stone bridge with a peaked pediment and arcades of small arches on either side, styled after Venice's Rialto Bridge.
road: A road narrowing into the distance between two converging edges, with a dashed center line of shrinking segments.
sand-snake: A serpent's body undulating in wide humps, ending in a head with an open mouth and flicking tongue.
sea-star: A five-pointed star with a smaller five-pointed star outlined within its center.
sewing-machine: A sewing machine in profile, showing two circular tension dials, a presser foot, and a slotted base plate.
shining-heart: A heart framed by radiating rays on every side, with a crescent nested inside its upper lobe.
ship-wreck: A ship tilted on its side and breaking apart above wavy water, with a life ring floating alongside.
snowman: A stacked snowman wearing a top hat, with round eyes, a carrot-shaped nose, thin branch arms, and buttons down its body.
spiral-thrust: Two crossed blades near a coiled spiral and crescent, trailing into a single thin blade pointed at the lower right.
squid: An octopus with an oval head, two round eyes, and several long tentacles trailing to one side beneath it.
sunflower: A ring of pointed petals surrounding a circular center dotted with small diamond-shaped marks.
tennis-racket: An oval-framed racket with a long handle beside a round ball.
thunder-blade: A lightning-bolt-shaped blade crossed diagonally with a straight sword, both trailing small jagged motion marks near the hilts.
time-trap: An hourglass framed between two swirling ribbon-like ovals above and below, as if caught in a vortex.
wine-glass: A stemmed goblet with a wide bowl marked by a horizontal line indicating liquid level, set on a round base.
zigzag-tune: Two musical notes joined by a jagged zigzag beam instead of a straight one.
